name: Autumn woodland
desc: A parting, a last good day, a walk where something finally gets said - warm colour with an ending inside it.
tags: scenery, no humans, autumn, deciduous forest, orange and red leaves, birch trunks, bare branches, fallen leaves carpet, leaf litter path, mist between trees
prose: an autumn woodland of birch and beech, orange and red leaves still on the branches and a thick carpet of fallen leaves over the path, with mist hanging between the trunks
note: Renders as a green forest with an orange tint unless the leaf litter on the GROUND is named - the floor is what sells autumn, not the canopy. It also runs away into postcard orange, and keeping bare branches and brown litter in the list alongside the red pulls it back. Careful stacking golden on top: the render is already saturated and the two compound.
